recipients.name: Supabase
recipients.purpose: Database that holds saved scans and sign-ups.
recipients.note: MPC-9885: webhook-receiver state-store.js keeps chat conversation state (24 h) whose keys and bodies carry phone, email, name and the platform user id (username); added phone, name, username. MPC-9885: mpt-leads saveBaseline sends SHA-256(email) as email_hash plus the scan scores; added email_hash. MPC-9885: partner-api monitors store the monitored value (email, phone, handle or a domain); added email_domain. MPC-9885: mpt-cairn-blackboard stores the investigation seed email and username and fact values (email, username; phone only if HASH_FACT_TYPES leaves it unhashed); username and phone were already listed (MPC-9885 other tasks). MPC-9885: social-listeners stores Telegram/X updates, probe captures and event-log rows (sender key, @username, name, message text; a shared contact adds a phone); added message_text. MPC-9885: shared/support rest-store.ts keeps support cases (message text and the sender's email, phone or handle); added message_text. MPC-9885: scan-report writes users/leads rows with the visitor IP and utm/referrer, and the listing inputs (name, phone, city, country); added utm, referrer, city, country.

recipients.name: Notion
recipients.purpose: Lead log.
recipients.note: MPC-9885: the mpt-leads lead row (workers/mpt-leads/worker.js) also carries city, browser/OS/device (device_profile), UTM tags and the referrer URL; added city, device_profile, utm, referrer. MPC-9885: the Cairn Notion mirror (mpt-cairn-blackboard/notion-sync.js) copies fact values as stored, so usernames reach Notion; added username.

recipients.name: Stripe
recipients.purpose: Starts a paid-plan Checkout session (gated by CHECKOUT_ENABLED; answers 503 and sends nothing until it is set).
recipients.note: MPC-9885: the entry named a flag (STRIPE_ENABLED) that no code reads. functions/api/stripe-checkout.ts is gated by CHECKOUT_ENABLED, so the entry now says that and is enabled: with the switch off no call is made, exactly as before. The call sends the plan name only (price id and plan in the return URL); the customer's card and email are entered at checkout.stripe.com by the visitor. MPC-9894: Privacy/Cookies must say Stripe is used once checkout is switched on, and that it is currently off.

recipients.name: Pwned Passwords

recipients.name: Meta Graph (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp)
recipients.purpose: Delivers WhatsApp replies (live) and Messenger replies (the Messenger adapter is still a stub that sends nothing until META_PAGE_ACCESS_KEY is set).
recipients.note: MPC-9885: switched ON because webhook-receiver sendWhatsApp already calls graph.facebook.com whenever META_WHATSAPP_KEY and WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID are set (it was seeded off as 'stubs'). Both senders self-gate on their own secrets, so no flag. phone added (WhatsApp `to`). MPC-9894: Privacy/Cookies must say WhatsApp is live.

retention.text: Provider-side (not verified in MPC-9885; MPC-9894 confirms before the DPA copy)

recipients.name: Cloudflare API (analytics reads)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own zone traffic totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. Read-only GraphQL; the request carries our API token and a date range. MPC-9885: flag corrected to CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN, the secret the collector reads (it skips the call when unset); CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is not set on that Worker.

recipients.name: Google Analytics Data API (reports)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own GA4 report totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: collector reads aggregate reports with our service-account token. The tag that sends visitor data to GA4 is the separate `ga4` entry. MPC-9885: flag corrected to GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, the secret the collector requires (GA4_PROPERTY_ID is a constant in code, not an env var).

recipients.name: YouTube Data API (channel stats)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own YouTube channel statistics for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885.

recipients.name: Meta Marketing API (ad insights)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own ad account totals for the metrics collector; read-only, sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. Separate from `meta-graph` (Messenger/Instagram/WhatsApp, still stubs and switched off).

recipients.name: Google Firestore (conversation state)
recipients.purpose: Stores per-conversation state for the chat channels so a reply can continue where it stopped.

retention.text: Provider-side (document ids carry the channel user id, phone or email)

recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: webhook-receiver firestore-client.js. Not in the Map's 29; MPC-9894 decides the DPA and Privacy wording. Also added name (the state holds the channel display name).

recipients.name: X (Twitter) API
recipients.purpose: Reads and posts on our own X account (mirror replies, media upload, channel probes).
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. `platform-replies` (the reply channels, flag-gated and off) keeps api.x.com too; this entry is the live account-level use. MPC-9885: flag is null, not X_BEARER_TOKEN: the DM, token-refresh and media-upload calls use the OAuth user token / consumer keys and ran without a bearer token, so a bearer flag would newly refuse them (the bearer-only lookups already skip themselves when it is unset).

recipients.name: Make.com webhooks (content hand-off)

recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: host is built from the MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL secret (hook.eu1.make.com today); the wrapper checks it at runtime.

recipients.name: GitHub Issues (support intake)

recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: shared/support/github-issue-intake.ts. Shares the host with `github-commit-search`; different purpose and data.

recipients.name: Our own Workers (service-to-service)

retention.text: Not stored by the call itself
